title: test(spec): three src/ test-budget rows trimmed, two at a one-program floor left listed
body:
Part of #23180
Clause-②: no

The five `packages/spec/src/` rows of the test-budget census, measured first. Three rows are trimmed in the test, with every `expect` line unchanged. Two rows are left unchanged: each one is already at its floor of one TypeScript program, which is neither of ruling record `6181973363`'s two classes, so they get no declaration (see the last section). This PR counts no row off the card: the next refresh list decides each one, per the card's pin.

## Readings, per file

CI readings are the vitest module line (seconds) in the `Test Core (1/6)` shard of the hourly runs that executed `@objectstack/spec` (no `cache hit` for it in the log): `38833767749` (01:11, head `4fe8b3def0`), `38838260718` (02:01, head `ec44cf60bf`) and `38848429828` (04:01, head `9b799e6fb5`). Run `38843417737` (03:01) replayed spec from the cache and is not used. The job-log blob host is unreachable from this container, so only each log's last 5000 lines were readable; that is why 04:01 has no reading for `view` and `app`.

Local readings are the sum of the file's case durations (ms), from vitest's JSON reporter. Each one is a five-file run with `--maxWorkers=2` under `os-verify-lock.sh` (shared-box ms), interleaved between a base worktree at `f846cc2020` and this branch. Three runs on each side.

| file (`src/`) | census | CI 01:11 / 02:01 / 04:01 | local before (ms) | local after (ms) | disposition |
|:--|--:|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `contracts/scoped-context.test.ts` | 91.1 | 14.7 / 14.0 / 16.7 | 2296 / 2050 / 2251 | file unchanged | unchanged: at its floor, no class |
| `integration/connector-author-shape.test.ts` | 49.5 | 16.8 / 15.9 / 18.1 | 2723 / 2323 / 2305 | file unchanged | unchanged: at its floor, no class |
| `kernel/metadata-type-registry-allow-org-override-absence.test.ts` | 11.4 | 8.8 / 11.1 / 10.3 | 1308 / 1244 / 1285 (alone) | 817 / 805 / 805 (alone) | trimmed |
| `ui/view.test.ts` | 10.9 | 9.1 / 10.7 / not readable | 3574 / 3226 / 3193 | 223 / 194 / 187 | trimmed |
| `ui/app.test.ts` | 10.8 | 10.2 / 10.8 / not readable | 1772 / 1723 / 1716 | 1244 / 1257 / 1172 | trimmed |

The allow-org row was re-measured alone, three runs on each side, after its second commit; the five-file runs before that commit read 1570 / 1359 / 1311 against 1235 / 1118 / 1102. If each file keeps its own CI-to-local ratio (slowest CI reading over the slowest local before-reading), the after-readings project to about 7.0 s (allow-org), 0.7 s (view) and 7.7 s (app) in the battery. That is NOT MEASURED on CI; this PR's own `Test Core (1/6)` run is the first post-trim reading.

The census premise still holds for all five: each row read over 10 s in at least one of the three executed runs.

## Trimmed: what each one waited on

- **`ui/view.test.ts`**: two cases took 1.1 to 1.6 s each, and all of it was `await import('../shared/index')`, `'../ui/index'` and `'../api/index'` inside the case, which loads three published entries. The three loads are now static imports at module top, which the census line does not count (AGENTS.md: "Clocked windows measure behaviour, never loading"). The four cases read the same module namespaces as before, so identity (`toBe`) assertions compare the same objects. Honest accounting: the load cost is moved, not removed. The five-file run's import phase rose from 2.4 to 2.9 s to 5.4 to 5.9 s, and its total wall went from 7.7 to 7.9 s to 7.2 to 7.7 s.
- **`ui/app.test.ts`**: the compiler-API case loaded `typescript` (about 300 ms) and `node:path` / `node:url` with `await import()` inside the case. They are now module-top imports. The rest of the case is one `ts.createProgram` over `app.zod.ts` (about 330 ms) and resolving `NavigationArea`'s members (about 640 ms). Neither the compiler options nor the lib set changes the latter, so that stays as is.
- **`kernel/metadata-type-registry-allow-org-override-absence.test.ts`**: the walk reads 8,792 files (about 290 ms, the declared radius) and parsed every file mentioning either name. Two costs were removable:
  1. A file holding both names was parsed twice. The two largest files in the radius are among them: `spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` (2.6 MB) and `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` (1.8 MB). Each file is now parsed once, and both names are read off that one tree (`codeReferencesByName`; the matcher's predicate is unchanged, and `codeReferences` is the one-name view of it).
  2. The new-name readers are asserted only by `arrayContaining` of three named files, so a reader anywhere else cannot change that verdict. Only those three files are now asked the new name (`NEW_READERS`, the same list the assertion uses). The old name is still read off every file in the radius that mentions it.

  Parsed bytes went from 14.6 MB to about 6 MB.

## Ablations: the changed allow-org paths still go red

Run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode on `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts`, which holds both names and is one of the three `NEW_READERS`. The expected direction was red every time, and red was observed every time. Each restore was proven by the tool: blob `5630b9de7b42` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No `dist/` is on the path, because the test reads source text.

- **A1**, `.filter((e) => e.allowEnvironmentOverlay)` changed to `.filter((e) => e.allowEnvironmentOverlay && !e.allowOrgOverride)` (blob to `b96bfd450123`): 1 of 2 failed, on the offenders assertion, naming `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts:406:52`. This is the old-name leg on a file parsed once for both names.
- **A2**, the same anchor changed to `.filter((e) => e.overlayGone)` (blob to `6132dc4d627f`): 1 of 2 failed, on `expect([...newReaders]).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(NEW_READERS))`. This is the new-name leg.

The `view` and `app` changes move import statements and change no logic, so they have no ablation.

## Verification

- The five files pass at ``2b6764e25d``: 586 tests across the five.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0. It includes `check:test-typecheck`, which compiles `src/**/*.test.ts` through `tsconfig.test.json` and held its debt ledger.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the three changed files: exit 0.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `2b6764e25d` derived 76 commands from the 3 changed paths (merge base `f846cc202`). All 76 ran here, each exit captured before any pipe. 74 exited 0. Two of them (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` and `lint`'s `check:doc-formula-expressions`) first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: a shallow clone, and an unbuilt `@objectstack/formula`); they exited 0 after `git fetch --unshallow` and a build of `@objectstack/lint`'s dependency closure. `--ran` reports "76 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 74 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)". The two are `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure`, which need every package's `dist/` built. Neither reads a test file. CI runs both.
- No publish: `npm pack --dry-run` of `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.2 lists 2094 files, 0 of them `*.test.ts`. The positive controls `dist/index.js` and `src/ui/view.zod.ts` are present. So `skip-changeset`.
- Local test scope: only the five named files ran here. The diff is test files only, and no other test imports them. CI's `Test Core` runs both spec projects.

## Not trimmed: `scoped-context` and `connector-author-shape` are at their floor

PR #23547 already folded each file's probes into one `ts.createProgram`. Timing that program per probe (an instrumented local copy, not committed) shows where the time goes. The first probe whose diagnostics are asked pays the whole type-graph resolution: 740 ms (`jsdoc-usage`) and 860 ms (`doc-l3-connector-0`). Every other probe takes 0 to 7 ms, except the second connector example at 117 ms. Program construction parses 586 and 614 files (the spec entry barrels a hook or connector author imports, `lib.dom.d.ts` and `@types/node`) in about 1.45 s each under two workers. Changing `lib` or `types` did not change the file count, because the spec source itself pulls those in.

So each file's floor is one compile of the spec's type graph. That is neither "spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture" nor "whole-package import", so these files carry no `// test-budget:` line, and they stay listed. Whether a third class is wanted is a question for the seat (the report's `open_questions`); it is not decided here.

## Acceptance notes

- The `view` trim moves load time from the clocked window to the import phase, as the repository's own rule for clocked windows says it should. It does not make the file cheaper end to end. The census line counts only the clocked window.
- The vitest module line excludes import time, so the census and these readings measure the clocked window only. This is the same caveat PR #23752 records.
